svg.title: Ahmed Hassan — animated software engineering profile dashboard
svg.desc: A dark developer command center with animated code, truthful workstream data, technology cards, current focus, workflow activity, and contact details.

g.text: I turn complex requirements into dependable, maintainable products.
My core work lives in PHP and Laravel, while C++ and Go sharpen how I think
about performance, concurrency, systems design, and clear architecture.
software that remains pleasant to work on after it ships.

svg.text: › Build with care · Optimize with purpose · Ship what matters. ‹
